emails.subject: Software Engineering Internship – Aditya Mittal
emails.body:
Hi Ashwin,

Intentport's concierge books the visit and hands your team the lead with the full conversation behind it, which means someone downstream still has to trust what a model produced.

I built MedVault, a Django backend that runs lab reports through a Gemini pipeline with a fixed JSON schema and a fallback parser for malformed output: https://medvault-xor.vercel.app

I just finished an SDET internship at Basepair, where I fixed a production OAuth race condition, and I'm looking for an internship or entry-level role, can join immediately. Does MicroPyramid take on engineering interns?

emails.subject: Software engineering intern at PolyMage
emails.body:
Hi Uday,

Compiling unmodified PyTorch straight to Tenstorrent devices means the compiler has to resolve the same call structure the original code relied on, without the author rewriting anything for it.

I built Canopy, a static analyzer that parses a repo in 10 languages into a call graph and marks unresolved calls as external instead of guessing: https://canopy-v7hb.onrender.com

I just finished an SDET internship at Basepair, where I fixed a production OAuth race condition, and I'm looking for an internship I can start immediately. Does PolyMage take on engineering interns?
